# degree-of-freedom work

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:dofWork`](gmeow-dofWork.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/dofWork>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/music`](../../slices/music.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The [`Work`](../classes/gmeow-Work.md) whose parameter determination this [`DegreeOfFreedom`](../classes/gmeow-DegreeOfFreedom.md) declares. Exactly one of [`dofWork`](gmeow-dofWork.md) or [`dofExpression`](gmeow-dofExpression.md) is required per relator; SHACL enforces the XOR ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).
